# CSV summary

`shared/scale_factors.json` is not present in `shared/`, so the requested scaled numeric means cannot be evaluated to numeric values. The expressions below give each requested mean once the corresponding column factor is available (`f_<column>`).

| File | Rows | Scaled numeric-column means |
|---|---:|---|
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | `time`: `2 × f_time`; `temperature`: `21.88 × f_temperature`; `humidity`: `40.36 × f_humidity` |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | `time`: `1.5 × f_time`; `temperature`: `20.15 × f_temperature`; `humidity`: `45.525 × f_humidity` |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | `time`: `2.5 × f_time`; `pressure`: `(6075.2 / 6) × f_pressure` (= `1012.5333333333 × f_pressure`) |

The row counts and unscaled column means were calculated directly from the CSV files. A numeric scaled summary requires the missing factor mapping.
